pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: aTa yanalokan gato naciketa tada yanonyalokan gatva sTitoBut yanaBaryaya krtanatiTipujan yajananaBavana grhnanityuktva dinatrayaparyantanupavasena tadgrha eva sTitavan tato yane cagate yanan prati BaryOktiprakaranaha- vEsvanara iti atiTi brahnano vEsvanarasan grhan pravisati grhesvagnipraveso yaTa taTa brahnanon brahnajnani atiTirupo grhanagatosatkrtascet dahatyevetyarTa taTa coktan sasWaskanDe- “agreraByagato nurti” (Baga.6.7.31 ) iti tasyagneriva praviswasyatiTeretan “sa idBojo yo grhave dadatyanakanaya carate krsaya " (kra.san.10.17.3) ityadisuktan santin kurvanti nahanto grhina ato heto vEvasvata vivasvata putra suryaputra, udakan udakadyatiTipujan asnE brahnanaya hara kurviti Baryovaca yanan pratityarTa 1.1.7 Endragnent

ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: evan yanenokto naciketa pratananekan varan tavat vrnuta ityaha vetapurusa- santeti he nrtyo kOtana nana pita santasankalpa nataniste santa sankalpa yasya sa tata, sunana sopanananaska yata syat, napi nan prati vitananyu- apakatakopa:, yata syatiti pratyekananveti tvatprasrstan tvaya presitan napi nan prati pratita pratyapicnanavan yata vatet, etat etan varanan pratanan varan vrne ityaha naciketa yanan pratityarta 1.1.10 Entraknent

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: svargyagnisvarupajnanalaksanan dvitiyan varan yacitun tadyancayan hetutaya svagrgyagnijnanaPalasvargasabditavisnulokasvarupanaha - svarga iti svarge loke svargasabdite Bagavaloke kincana kinapi Bayan nasti tatra loke tvan ca nasi, siksakasaniti Bava na jaraya biBeti, talokan gata iti yojyan asanayapipase uBe tirtva sokatiga sokanatikrantasan nodate= suKananuBavati svargaloka iti punaruktiradararTan yadva, nayan loka visnuloka, kintu prasidDasvargaloka eveti jnapanaya punarukti “prapya svargan tatra Bayatiga usya nanvantaran kalan ” ityadi Basyokte 1.1.12 Endragnent

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: evan svargyagnijnanaPalan nirupya svargyanin prcCati - satvaniti nrtyo sa tvan svargyan uktarupasvargasaDananagnin agnisabditeswakacitisTa- nagryatvadigunayuktatayagninanakan harin aDyesi janasi tan citisTa- nagninanakan harin sradaDanaya nahyan bruhi kuta: ? na hi svargyatvanatrena tadvacananavasyakanityata aha- svargeti svargo loko yesan te taTokta nanvantaran svarloke sTasyanta pascadanrtatvan nuktin Bajante prapnuvanti etat etan dvitiyena varena dvitiyan varan vrna ityarTa 1.1.13 Endragnent
ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: evan svarkyaknicnanapalan nirupya svarkyanin prcati - satvaniti nrtyo sa tvan svarkyan uktarupasvarkasatananaknin aknisaptitestakacitista- nakryatvatikunayuktatayakninanakan harin atyesi canasi tan citista- nakninanakan harin sratatanaya nahyan pruhi kuta: ? na hi svarkyatvanatrena tatvacananavasyakanityata aha- svarketi svarko loko yesan te tatokta nanvantaran svarloke stasyanta pascatanrtatvan nuktin pacante prapnuvanti etat etan tvitiyena varena tvitiyan varan vrna ityarta 1.1.13 Entraknent

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: iti yacito yana pratyuvacetyaha- prata iti he naciketa, svargyan svargasaDananagnin citisTanagninanakan harin prajanan ahan te tuByan prabravini pravacni tadu tadeva tvaya prswan nayocyananananinanakan citisTaharisvarupaneva ne natsakasat niboDa nibuDyasva janihi pratijnatan svargyagnisvarupanuktavanityaha- ananteti anantalokapti- nanantasya visnulokasyaptinaptisaDanan, aTo kinca, pratisWan sarvaloka-pratisWahetun guhayan sarvapranihrdayaguhayan nihitan nitaran sTitan sarvalokananadin karanaButan tanetanagnin citisTanagninanakan harin tvan vidDi janihi ityuvaca yana 1.1.13 Endragnent
ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: iti yacito yana pratyuvacetyaha- prata iti he naciketa, svarkyan svarkasatananaknin citistanakninanakan harin pracanan ahan te tupyan prapravini pravacni tatu tateva tvaya prstan nayocyananananinanakan citistaharisvarupaneva ne natsakasat nipota niputyasva canihi praticnatan svarkyaknisvarupanuktavanityaha- ananteti anantalokapti- nanantasya visnulokasyaptinaptisatanan, ato kinca, pratistan sarvaloka-pratistahetun kuhayan sarvapranihrtayakuhayan nihitan nitaran stitan sarvalokananatin karanaputan tanetanaknin citistanakninanakan harin tvan viti canihi ityuvaca yana 1.1.13 Entraknent

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: kinahetyata aha- taniti tan naciketasan priyanana pritinan san nahatna nahanana yanobravit ityuktanuvada adararTa adya idanin Buya puna, varatrayadanyaniti yavat, varan iha citivisaye tava dadani - tyabravidityarTa tan varanaha- tavEveti ayanagni iswakacitirupogni taba nanEva naciketagnirityevan rupena Bavita Bavisyati, Bavatviti vyatyayo va anekarupan bahurupan, svarnanayiniti yavat, “bahurupan ca purawan kartasvaranitiryate” ityukte srnkan kanWanalan cenan grhanetyabravidityanvaya 1.1.16 Endragnent
ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: kinahetyata aha- taniti tan naciketasan priyanana pritinan san nahatna nahanana yanopravit ityuktanuvata atararta atya itanin puya puna, varatrayatanyaniti yavat, varan iha citivisaye tava tatani - tyapravitityarta tan varanaha- tavEveti ayanakni istakacitirupokni tapa nanEva naciketaknirityevan rupena pavita pavisyati, pavatviti vyatyayo va anekarupan pahurupan, svarnanayiniti yavat, “pahurupan ca puratan kartasvaranitiryate” ityukte srnkan kantanalan cenan krhanetyapravitityanvaya 1.1.16 Entraknent

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: ‘“tavEva nana Bavitayanagni" ityuktan taTEva vyavaharan tadanusWatrPalanaha - trinaciketa iti naciketasoyan naciketa naciketasa iti vaktavye Candasa salopa trayo naciketa yasyasO trinaciketa, trivaranusWitanaciketananakagnicayana punanityarTa triBirvedE sanDin sanDanan etya prapya yo vartate vedatrayavirudDo vartate, vedatrayoktanargena Bagavatatvadikan janan vartata iti yavat ‘“triBiretya sanDin” ityasya purvatrotaratra canvaya trikarnakrt yajnadanatapa karta, jananrtyu tarati nukto BavatityarTa kinetavatEva trinaciketatvatrikarna- krtvanatrena nukto Bavatityata triBiretya sanDinityuktan Bagavatatvadi- jnananapyavasyakaniti Bavena tadvyanakti- brahnajajnaniti brahna veda tatra vyaktatvat brahnajo visnu, "saptanyan janerqa: ” (si. kO. 307) janatiti jna sarvajna, " igupaDajnaprikira ka " (si.kO. 2897) brahnajascasO jnasca brahnajajna tan devan kriqadigunavisiswan, iqyan brahnadiBi stutyan, nicaya vicarya, viditva saksatkrtya, inan bedadyuktan purvotarajananrtyutaranarupan vaksyananarupan va, santin atyantan yaTa Bavati taTa eti prapnoti iti 1.1.17 Endragnent
ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: ‘“tavEva nana pavitayanakni" ityuktan tatEva vyavaharan tatanustatrpalanaha - trinaciketa iti naciketasoyan naciketa naciketasa iti vaktavye cantasa salopa trayo naciketa yasyasO trinaciketa, trivaranustitanaciketananakaknicayana punanityarta tripirvetE santin santanan etya prapya yo vartate vetatrayaviruto vartate, vetatrayoktanarkena pakavatatvatikan canan vartata iti yavat ‘“tripiretya santin” ityasya purvatrotaratra canvaya trikarnakrt yacnatanatapa karta, cananrtyu tarati nukto pavatityarta kinetavatEva trinaciketatvatrikarna- krtvanatrena nukto pavatityata tripiretya santinityuktan pakavatatvati- cnananapyavasyakaniti pavena tatvyanakti- prahnacacnaniti prahna veta tatra vyaktatvat prahnaco visnu, "saptanyan canerta: ” (si. kO. 307) canatiti cna sarvacna, " ikupatacnaprikira ka " (si.kO. 2897) prahnacascasO cnasca prahnacacna tan tevan kritatikunavisistan, ityan prahnatipi stutyan, nicaya vicarya, vititva saksatkrtya, inan petatyuktan purvotaracananrtyutaranarupan vaksyananarupan va, santin atyantan yata pavati tata eti prapnoti iti 1.1.17 Entraknent

ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: harernahinantaranaha - hansa iti “ ohak tyake ityasnatanu- pratyaye tilope haniti rupan sarapatasyantalope visarke hrasve ca sa iti rupan hancasO tosahinasvasO sasca sararupasveti- hansa ‘“nityan hinokilErtosE” ityatisnrtya niruktatvena yatayokan prakrtipratyaya uhya sucO vayavastiti sucisat vayusta: sucisaptopapatataste satrpratyaye ‘inasoralopa’” (si.kO. 2469) ityakaralope satve ca sucisatiti rupan evanakrepi potyan van varan su sukan yasya sa vasu purvapate rasaptalopa antariksasat antariksaka hota "hu tanatanayo” ityata kartari trc cuhoti saptativisayanati anupavatiti intriyatista petyan pucyatayastiti vetisat ati atisayitan tananan yasya sotita sa evatiti sonarasapatre tronakalase tistatiti turonasat nrsvastiti nrsat varesu prahnatitevesu astiti varasat rte yatartarupe vete astiti=kratasat vyonasat prakrtista vyotanasyan cakatiti cakatataraputa sri: vyonetyucyate vipurvat ‘“uyi tantu santane" iti tatoratikarane nanpratyaye kunentalope vyoneti site apsu cayanta ityapcani tesvasta - ityapca apcasaptopapatataste kvip pratyaye sakarasya rutve visarke savarnatirke ca apca iti pavati evanakrepi koca kosu catesvasta iti koca rtesu pakavantan praptesu, nuktesviti yavat tesu catani cnanatini tatrasta iti rtaca atrisu catesu asta ityatvica rtan nukyato- vetapratipatyan purnakunatvat prhat etatvE tatiti atra utaratra canusancaniyan 2.2.2 Entraknent
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थखण्डार्थ: हरेर्महिमान्तरमाह - हंस इति “ ओहाक् त्यागे'' इत्यस्माड्डमु- प्रत्यये टिलोपे हमिति रूपम् सारपदस्यान्तलोपे विसर्ग

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: “angusWanatra puruso naDya atnani tisWati" ityukto jiva iti codyan isana ityutararDe nirankusaButaBavyasarvaprerakatvaBagavalingena nirastan prak aDuna angusWanatrataya naDye sTitasya vyaparavisesan vadaneva niravakasa- bananasrutyadina ca jiva iti codyan niraha - urDvaniti yatacCabdatra grahyO yongusWanatratvadina pragukta pranan pranavayun urDvanunayati urDvagatinataya prerayati apanan ca vayun pratyagaDa vinutradiniskasana- hetutaya aspati prerayati tan naDye hrdi asinan vananan visve sarve deva upasata iti etena pranapanaprerakatvalingena praguktesano nuKya prana ityapi codyan nirastan niravakasavananasrutyade, sarvaprerake harO sate pancasanyayena pranapanaprerakatvasyapi sanBavat taTa ca sutran - " sabdadeva pranita " iti (bra.su.1-3-24) 2.2.3 Endragnent
ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: “ankustanatra puruso natya atnani tistati" ityukto civa iti cotyan isana ityutararte nirankusaputapavyasarvaprerakatvapakavalinkena nirastan prak atuna ankustanatrataya natye stitasya vyaparavisesan vataneva niravakasa- pananasrutyatina ca civa iti cotyan niraha - urtvaniti yatacaptatra krahyO yonkustanatratvatina prakukta pranan pranavayun urtvanunayati urtvakatinataya prerayati apanan ca vayun pratyakata vinutratiniskasana- hetutaya aspati prerayati tan natye hrti asinan vananan visve sarve teva upasata iti etena pranapanaprerakatvalinkena prakuktesano nukya prana ityapi cotyan nirastan niravakasavananasrutyate, sarvaprerake harO sate pancasanyayena pranapanaprerakatvasyapi sanpavat tata ca sutran - " saptateva pranita " iti (pra.su.1-3-24) 2.2.3 Entraknent
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थखण्डार्थ: “अङ्गुष्ठमात्रः पुरुषो मध्य आत्मनि तिष्ठति" इत्युक्तो जीव इति चोद्यं ईशान इत्युत्तरार्धे निरङ्कुशभूतभव्यसर्वप्र

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: kanscidBagavadgunanuktva tusnin sTitan yanan punastadgunan vaktun prcCati naciketa - asyeti sarirasTasya asya dehino jivasya vistransananasya sTulan dehan tyajata dehat suksnadehat vinucyananasya tadapi tyajata, atra nuktO niyanakan kin kidrsan parisisyata iti prasna, utaranaha- etadvE taditi tvaya prswan tadvastu etadvE vaksyananagunakataya parisisyananan vE ityarTa 2.2.4 Endragnent
ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: kanscitpakavatkunanuktva tusnin stitan yanan punastatkunan vaktun prcati naciketa - asyeti sarirastasya asya tehino civasya vistransananasya stulan tehan tyacata tehat suksnatehat vinucyananasya tatapi tyacata, atra nuktO niyanakan kin kitrsan parisisyata iti prasna, utaranaha- etatvE tatiti tvaya prstan tatvastu etatvE vaksyananakunakataya parisisyananan vE ityarta 2.2.4 Entraknent
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थखण्डार्थ: कांश्चिद्भगवद्गुणानुक्त्वा तूष्णीं स्थितं यमं पुनस्तद्गुणान् वक्तुं पृच्छति नचिकेताः - अस्येति शरीरस्थस्य अस्य

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: sarvajivanahetvo nuKyavayurupayorapi prerakatvagunan parisisyanana- syaha- neti nuKyapranarupaByan pranapanaByan na jivati cetanarasi, kintvitarena sa ka ? yasninetO pranapanO upasritO tenetareneti BagavatpreritaByan etaByan jivati na svatantraByaniti yavat etadvE taditi purvenanvaya sarvajivanadanuKyapranaprerakatvagunayuktan vE taditi 2.2.5 Endragnent
ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: sarvacivanahetvo nukyavayurupayorapi prerakatvakunan parisisyanana- syaha- neti nukyapranarupapyan pranapanapyan na civati cetanarasi, kintvitarena sa ka ? yasninetO pranapanO upasritO tenetareneti pakavatpreritapyan etapyan civati na svatantrapyaniti yavat etatvE tatiti purvenanvaya sarvacivanatanukyapranaprerakatvakunayuktan vE tatiti 2.2.5 Entraknent
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थखण्डार्थ: सर्वजीवनहेत्वोः मुख्यवायुरूपयोरपि प्रेरकत्वगुणं परिशिष्यमाण- स्याह- नेति मुख्यप्राणरूपाभ्यां प्राणापानाभ्यां न

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: tatra brahnagunan iyata nirupyotaratrapi jivaBedakagunan brahnano vivaksuritareneti purvanantre Bedasya prastutatvat tatprakawanaya naranan prapya atna jivo yaTa Bavati taca vaksyanityuktan brahnanyayuktan Darnan jivasyaha- yoniniti dehino dehaDaranayogya anye kecana jiva sariratvaya, arsa adyac pratyayantat tvapratyaya, sariravatvaya yonin prapadyante prapnuvanti kaTan ? yaTakarna yaTasrutan, svasvavidyakarnanatikranena anye dehina sTanun sTavaran dehan sanyanti svakiyakarnadyanusareneti 2.2.7 Endragnent
ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: tatra prahnakunan iyata nirupyotaratrapi civapetakakunan prahnano vivaksuritareneti purvanantre petasya prastutatvat tatprakatanaya naranan prapya atna civo yata pavati taca vaksyanityuktan prahnanyayuktan tarnan civasyaha- yoniniti tehino tehataranayokya anye kecana civa sariratvaya, arsa atyac pratyayantat tvapratyaya, sariravatvaya yonin prapatyante prapnuvanti katan ? yatakarna yatasrutan, svasvavityakarnanatikranena anye tehina stanun stavaran tehan sanyanti svakiyakarnatyanusareneti 2.2.7 Entraknent
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थखण्डार्थ: तत्र ब्रह्मगुणान् इयता निरूप्योत्तरत्रापि जीवभेदकगुणान् ब्रह्मणो विवक्षुरितरेणेति पूर्वमन्त्रे भेदस्य प्रस्तुतत

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: jivaBedakagunayuktatvena Bagavato nahinananaha - ya esa iti ya esa puruso Bagavan suptesu jivesu kanan kanan svecCanusareneti va kanyananan svapnapadarTajataniti varTa, nirnanana utpadayan jagarti tadaha sutre ‘“nirnataran cEke putradayasca’” (bra.su. 3-2-2) iti tadeveti viDeyapeksaya napunsakatvan sukran sokarahitan tadbrahna tadevanrtananasvaranucyate vedadisu prajnEriti va tasniniti nahinantaran etadvE tat tvaya prswan tat ya esa ityadinoktagunakan vE 2.2.8 Endragnent
ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: civapetakakunayuktatvena pakavato nahinananaha - ya esa iti ya esa puruso pakavan suptesu civesu kanan kanan svecanusareneti va kanyananan svapnapatartacataniti varta, nirnanana utpatayan cakarti tataha sutre ‘“nirnataran cEke putratayasca’” (pra.su. 3-2-2) iti tateveti viteyapeksaya napunsakatvan sukran sokarahitan tatprahna tatevanrtananasvaranucyate vetatisu pracnEriti va tasniniti nahinantaran etatvE tat tvaya prstan tat ya esa ityatinoktakunakan vE 2.2.8 Entraknent
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थखण्डार्थ: जीवभेदकगुणयुक्तत्वेन भगवतो महिमानमाह - य एष इति य एष पुरुषो भगवान् सुप्तेषु जीवेषु कामं कामं स्वेच्छानुसारेणेति

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: “na pranena” ityuktan sarvajivaniyantrtvan drswantaByan vyanakti- agniryaTetyadina nantradvayena Buvanan praviswa cetanogni yaTEka pakadikarta nanya taTapyasya cetanagne rupan rupan pratiti sesa, pratityasyavrtirva, rupan rupan prati pratirupa pratibinbo baBuva jiva dvayorapi yoninityadina prakrtatvat tadaha sutre - “aBasa eva ca’” (bra.su.2-3-49) iti pratibinbatvan ca tadaDinatve sati kincitatsadrsatvan jneyan kin tayoraBeda ? netyaha- bahisceti binbasvarupad bahirButasca, na tatsvarupatnetyarTa 2.2.9 vayuryaTeti yaTa cetanavayurityadirupena pragvadyojana 2.2.10 klisyananajagadanta praviswasyapi klesa syaditi codyan sadrswantan niraha - suryo yaTeti caksurdviviDan bahyanantaran ceti bahyan jaqan antaran tu tadaBinanisuryacetanarupan “adityascaksurButvaksini pravisat” (E.u.2.3.2) ityade taTa ca yaTa surya sarvalokasya caksu caksurniyantrtaya caksurnanaka: caksurantasTa sanapi caksusE bahyadosE bahyacaksusanbanDiBi dosErna lipyate taTEka svatantra bahyo jivasvarupanatnaka bahirButasana lipyate, svatantratvaditi Bava tadaha sutre - ‘“sanBogapraptiriti cena vEsesyat (bra. su. 1-2 - 8) iti 2.2.1 Endragnent
ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: “na pranena” ityuktan sarvacivaniyantrtvan trstantapyan vyanakti- akniryatetyatina nantratvayena puvanan pravista cetanokni yatEka pakatikarta nanya tatapyasya cetanakne rupan rupan pratiti sesa, pratityasyavrtirva, rupan rupan prati pratirupa pratipinpo papuva civa tvayorapi yoninityatina prakrtatvat tataha sutre - “apasa eva ca’” (pra.su.2-3-49) iti pratipinpatvan ca tatatinatve sati kincitatsatrsatvan cneyan kin tayorapeta ? netyaha- pahisceti pinpasvarupat pahirputasca, na tatsvarupatnetyarta 2.2.9 vayuryateti yata cetanavayurityatirupena prakvatyocana 2.2.10 klisyananacakatanta pravistasyapi klesa syatiti cotyan satrstantan niraha - suryo yateti caksurtvivitan pahyanantaran ceti pahyan catan antaran tu tatapinanisuryacetanarupan “atityascaksurputvaksini pravisat” (E.u.2.3.2) ityate tata ca yata surya sarvalokasya caksu caksurniyantrtaya caksurnanaka: caksurantasta sanapi caksusE pahyatosE pahyacaksusanpantipi tosErna lipyate tatEka svatantra pahyo civasvarupanatnaka pahirputasana lipyate, svatantratvatiti pava tataha sutre - ‘“sanpokapraptiriti cena vEsesyat (pra. su. 1-2 - 8) iti 2.2.1 Entraknent
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थखण्डार्थ: “न प्राणेन” इत्युक्तं सर्वजीवनियन्तृत्वं दृष्टान्ताभ्यां व्यनक्ति- अग्निर्यथेत्यादिना मन्त्रद्वयेन भुवनं प्रविष

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: ekapadoktan svatantryan vyanjayan ekasya nanajivaniyantrtvan kaTaniti codyan bahurupatvotya niraha eko basiti kEnutyenapi Bagavato duKasprswatvanaha- taniti ye atnasTan pasyanti tesanapi sarvaduKaprahanena sasvatan suKan kila tasya hare kaTan duKasparsa iti Bava 2.2.12 “eko vasi” ityuktan svatantryan sanarTayate - nitya iti nityanan vastunan nityotisayena nitya cetananan cetano nuKyacetana anye cetanaBasa, tadaDina iti yavat paranacetanatvatsvatantra svatantratvad duKaslesa iti Bava: bahunan cetananan santi suKan 2.2.13 Bagavato nahinantaranaha - tadetaditi tat " guhyan brahna" ityupakrantan etat ekan rupan iti naDye coktan brahnana rupananirdesyanidanitTa-niti nirdeswunasakyan paranan suKan anirdesyaparanasuKatnakaniti enan jnanina nanyante tatadrk suKatnakan Bagavadrupan kaTan nu janiyan tatprasadanrte ? kinu Bati na Bati veti wikayan tu yadanirdesyan suKan kaTan nu tadvijaniyanityanukulyena grhnanti tadanirdesyan suKan etatprakrtanatnano rupaniti nanyanta iti yojanokta janiyaniti prarTanayan lin jnanarTan prarTitatvananukulyena grahanan 2.2.14 Endragnent
ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: ekapatoktan svatantryan vyancayan ekasya nanacivaniyantrtvan kataniti cotyan pahurupatvotya niraha eko pasiti kEnutyenapi pakavato tukasprstatvanaha- taniti ye atnastan pasyanti tesanapi sarvatukaprahanena sasvatan sukan kila tasya hare katan tukasparsa iti pava 2.2.12 “eko vasi” ityuktan svatantryan sanartayate - nitya iti nityanan vastunan nityotisayena nitya cetananan cetano nukyacetana anye cetanapasa, tatatina iti yavat paranacetanatvatsvatantra svatantratvat tukaslesa iti pava: pahunan cetananan santi sukan 2.2.13 pakavato nahinantaranaha - tatetatiti tat " kuhyan prahna" ityupakrantan etat ekan rupan iti natye coktan prahnana rupananirtesyanitanita-niti nirtestunasakyan paranan sukan anirtesyaparanasukatnakaniti enan cnanina nanyante tatatrk sukatnakan pakavatrupan katan nu caniyan tatprasatanrte ? kinu pati na pati veti tikayan tu yatanirtesyan sukan katan nu tatvicaniyanityanukulyena krhnanti tatanirtesyan sukan etatprakrtanatnano rupaniti nanyanta iti yocanokta caniyaniti prartanayan lin cnanartan prartitatvananukulyena krahanan 2.2.14 Entraknent
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थखण्डार्थ: एकपदोक्तं स्वातन्त्र्यं व्यञ्जयन् एकस्य नानाजीवनियन्तृत्वं कथमिति चोद्यं बहुरूपत्वोत्त्या निराह एको बशीति कैमुत

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: tasya nahinantaranaha - na tatreti tatra “kaTan nu tadvijaniyan" ityatra tatpadokte jnanarTan prarTite vastuni suryadirna Bati na Basayate candratarakaniti dvandvEkavadBava taneva Bantananu tadBanananusrtya sarvan suryaditejojatan Bati tasya Basa sarvanidan jagat viBatiti taTa ca sutran ‘“anukrtestasya ca’" (bra.su.1.3.2) iti 2.2.15 iti dvitiyaDyayasya dvitiya vali Endragnent
ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: tasya nahinantaranaha - na tatreti tatra “katan nu tatvicaniyan" ityatra tatpatokte cnanartan prartite vastuni suryatirna pati na pasayate cantratarakaniti tvantvEkavatpava taneva pantananu tatpanananusrtya sarvan suryatitecocatan pati tasya pasa sarvanitan cakat vipatiti tata ca sutran ‘“anukrtestasya ca’" (pra.su.1.3.2) iti 2.2.15 iti tvitiyatyayasya tvitiya vali Entraknent
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थखण्डार्थ: तस्य महिमान्तरमाह - न तत्रेति तत्र “कथं नु तद्विजानीयाम्" इत्यत्र तत्पदोक्ते ज्ञानार्थं प्रार्थिते वस्तुनि सूर्

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: saDunan Bagavanahino budDayarohaya lokaprasidDarTasanyena tanahinananaha - urDvati urDva sarvoco Bagavan nulan vrksanulan Butalaniva nulan yasya jagadaKyavrksasya sa urDvanula avak arvanca aDana deva saKa yasyasO avaksaKa Bunigatavrksanulan tu sritatvan jneyan esa prananapranito jagadaKyosvatTa asvatTataruriva sTita asu gatinatvadasvo hari asupapadat vaDato kapratyaye upapadantalope hrasvatve ca asva iti sidDe, asva asninstisWatiti va, asvasya Tanananiti vasvatTa sanatana pravahatonadi tadeva urDvaKyan nulaneva sukran vyaKyatani padani etadvE tat tvaya prswan etadrsagunakan vE iti 2.3.1 Endragnent
ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: satunan pakavanahino putayarohaya lokaprasitartasanyena tanahinananaha - urtvati urtva sarvoco pakavan nulan vrksanulan putalaniva nulan yasya cakatakyavrksasya sa urtvanula avak arvanca atana teva saka yasyasO avaksaka punikatavrksanulan tu sritatvan cneyan esa prananapranito cakatakyosvata asvatataruriva stita asu katinatvatasvo hari asupapatat vatato kapratyaye upapatantalope hrasvatve ca asva iti site, asva asninstistatiti va, asvasya tanananiti vasvata sanatana pravahatonati tateva urtvakyan nulaneva sukran vyakyatani patani etatvE tat tvaya prstan etatrsakunakan vE iti 2.3.1 Entraknent
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थखण्डार्थ: साधूनां भगवन्महिम्नो बुद्धयारोहाय लोकप्रसिद्धार्थसाम्येन तन्महिमानमाह - ऊर्ध्वति ऊर्ध्वः सर्वोच्चो भगवान् मूलं

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: yadidaniti yadidan kinca sarvan jagat pranaKye harO sTitan prananisrtan tadidan jagat yasnadejati yatpreranaya ceswate tat vajran vajravat nahadBayan nahadBayadan, udyatan utkrswayatnavantan etat etan ye vidu te anrta nukta Bavanti Basyawikayostu, prana sarvanidan, kinca jagaca yasnanisrtan ejati ceswate ca, sarvan jagadyasnanisrtan sa prano yasnaceswata iti varTa vajrapadasya tu ‘“varjanadvajranucyate " iti snrtya yogaruQiByan ca vajrasabdarTo Bagavanityuktan tadahan sutrakara “ kanpanat (bra.su. 2.3.39 ) iti 2.3.2 Endragnent
ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: yatitaniti yatitan kinca sarvan cakat pranakye harO stitan prananisrtan tatitan cakat yasnatecati yatpreranaya cestate tat vacran vacravat nahatpayan nahatpayatan, utyatan utkrstayatnavantan etat etan ye vitu te anrta nukta pavanti pasyatikayostu, prana sarvanitan, kinca cakaca yasnanisrtan ecati cestate ca, sarvan cakatyasnanisrtan sa prano yasnacestata iti varta vacrapatasya tu ‘“varcanatvacranucyate " iti snrtya yokarutipyan ca vacrasaptarto pakavanityuktan tatahan sutrakara “ kanpanat (pra.su. 2.3.39 ) iti 2.3.2 Entraknent
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थखण्डार्थ: यदिदमिति यदिदं किञ्च सर्वं जगत् प्राणाख्ये हरौ स्थितं प्राणान्निस्सृतं तदिदं जगत् यस्मादेजति यत्प्रेरणया चेष्टत

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: balya eva sanpaditajnanan naciketasan drswva visnitonyopyevan kuryadityasayavan taTa kartu Palanaha - iha cediti iha nanusyadehe sarirasya BOtikadehasya visrasa visransanat patanat prak bodDunasakat saktascet sa svargesu lekesu vEkunWadisu sariratvaya aprakrtacidanandatnaka- dehavatvaya kalpate, nukto Bavatiti yavat 2.3.4 Endragnent
ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: palya eva sanpatitacnanan naciketasan trstva visnitonyopyevan kuryatityasayavan tata kartu palanaha - iha cetiti iha nanusyatehe sarirasya pOtikatehasya visrasa visransanat patanat prak potunasakat saktascet sa svarkesu lekesu vEkuntatisu sariratvaya aprakrtacitanantatnaka- tehavatvaya kalpate, nukto pavatiti yavat 2.3.4 Entraknent
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थखण्डार्थ: बाल्य एव सम्पादितज्ञानं नचिकेतसं दृष्ट्वा विस्मितोऽन्योऽप्येवं कुर्यादित्याशयवान् तथा कर्तुः फलमाह - इह चेदिति

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: uktopayErjayananopi BagavadboDo nEkaviDa ityaha- yaTeti atnani jivevasTito Bagavan, adarse darpane nuKan yaTa drsyate sanyak taTa jnanadrswiBi drsyate yaTa svapne padarTo drsyate taTa pitrleke drsyate na sanyagityarTa yaTapsu pariva sanyagiva, pratinuKadikan drsyate taTa ganDarvaloke kincitspaswataya drsyate brahnaloke tu Cayatapayo Cayatapanilitapradese vastu yaTahani drsyate taTa harirdrsyata ityarTa 2.3.5 Endragnent
ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: uktopayErcayananopi pakavatpoto nEkavita ityaha- yateti atnani civevastito pakavan, atarse tarpane nukan yata trsyate sanyak tata cnanatrstipi trsyate yata svapne patarto trsyate tata pitrleke trsyate na sanyakityarta yatapsu pariva sanyakiva, pratinukatikan trsyate tata kantarvaloke kincitspastataya trsyate prahnaloke tu cayatapayo cayatapanilitapratese vastu yatahani trsyate tata harirtrsyata ityarta 2.3.5 Entraknent
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थखण्डार्थ: उक्तोपायैर्जायमानोऽपि भगवद्बोधो नैकविध इत्याह- यथेति आत्मनि जीवेऽवस्थितो भगवान्, आदर्शे दर्पणे मुखं यथा दृश्यते

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: ‘iha cedasakadbodDun ” ityuktan tatra kasya boDat svargaloko Bavatityato bodDavyanaha- indriyananiti prTagBavan taratanyan, yaca jagadudayastanayO Bavata prTak nanaprakarenotpadyanananan indriyanan satapratityadikaniti sesa, natva BagavadaDinan jnatva, na socati 2.3.6 Endragnent
ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: ‘iha cetasakatpotun ” ityuktan tatra kasya potat svarkaloko pavatityato potavyanaha- intriyananiti prtakpavan taratanyan, yaca cakatutayastanayO pavata prtak nanaprakarenotpatyanananan intriyanan satapratityatikaniti sesa, natva pakavatatinan cnatva, na socati 2.3.6 Entraknent
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थखण्डार्थ: ‘‘इह चेदशकद्बोद्धुम् ” इत्युक्तम् तत्र कस्य बोधात् स्वर्गलोको भवतीत्यतो बोद्धव्यमाह- इन्द्रियाणामिति पृथग्भावं

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: tan jnatva nucyate ityuktan nuktihetujnanan na caksuradinanayasa - saDyan, kintu Baktisravanadyupodbalitena nanasEvetyaha- na sandrsa iti sandrse sanyajnanaya asya nanavataranidanaButasya nularupasya prakrtaBagavato rupan na tisWati avyaktEkasvaBavatvat, acintyanahinatvaca vastusvaBavo durdarsa ityuktatvat karananyapi na tatra saktinantityaha - na caksuseti upalaksanan caksuradikaranE kascidapyenan na pasyati etena natsyakurnadescaksusa darsanana caksusa pasyatiti kaTaniti parastan nularupasyEvanBavokte tarhi kenetyata aha- hrdeti hrcCabdotra sravananananaDyanaBatyadisaDanapara tadyuktena nanasa nanisa jnanarupi BagavanaBilrpto visayikrto Bavati nucyate nukto Bavatiti pragekavacanotya jnanisveka eva nucyata iti praptasankan varayitunaha- ya enaniti enan purusan taTa ca sutran “aniyana sarvesan” (bra.su.3-3-35) iti 2.3.9 Endragnent
ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: tan cnatva nucyate ityuktan nuktihetucnanan na caksuratinanayasa - satyan, kintu paktisravanatyupotpalitena nanasEvetyaha- na santrsa iti santrse sanyacnanaya asya nanavataranitanaputasya nularupasya prakrtapakavato rupan na tistati avyaktEkasvapavatvat, acintyanahinatvaca vastusvapavo turtarsa ityuktatvat karananyapi na tatra saktinantityaha - na caksuseti upalaksanan caksuratikaranE kascitapyenan na pasyati etena natsyakurnatescaksusa tarsanana caksusa pasyatiti kataniti parastan nularupasyEvanpavokte tarhi kenetyata aha- hrteti hrcaptotra sravananananatyanapatyatisatanapara tatyuktena nanasa nanisa cnanarupi pakavanapilrpto visayikrto pavati nucyate nukto pavatiti prakekavacanotya cnanisveka eva nucyata iti praptasankan varayitunaha- ya enaniti enan purusan tata ca sutran “aniyana sarvesan” (pra.su.3-3-35) iti 2.3.9 Entraknent
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थखण्डार्थ: तं ज्ञात्वा मुच्यते इत्युक्तं मुक्तिहेतुज्ञानं न चक्षुरादिनानायास - साध्यम्, किन्तु भक्तिश्रवणाद्युपोद्बलितेन म

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: hrda nanasetyatra hrdetyuktasaDanesu aByarhitan jnanasaDanan kinityata pratyaharasidDaDaranadirupan Dyananityaha - yadeti jnanani, karane lyuw, jnanasaDanani caksuradipancendriyani nanasa saha yadavatisWante visayeBya vyavrtataya tisWanti, budDisca na viceswate visayan prati na pravartate, tan saptananindriyanan visayeBya pratyaharan paranan gatin paranasaDanan jnanasyahurityarTa taniti paWe gatyapeksaya strilingatvan 2.3.10 Endragnent
ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: hrta nanasetyatra hrtetyuktasatanesu apyarhitan cnanasatanan kinityata pratyaharasitataranatirupan tyananityaha - yateti cnanani, karane lyut, cnanasatanani caksuratipancentriyani nanasa saha yatavatistante visayepya vyavrtataya tistanti, putisca na vicestate visayan prati na pravartate, tan saptananintriyanan visayepya pratyaharan paranan katin paranasatanan cnanasyahurityarta taniti pate katyapeksaya strilinkatvan 2.3.10 Entraknent
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थखण्डार्थ: हृदा मनसेत्यत्र हृदेत्युक्तसाधनेषु अभ्यर्हितं ज्ञानसाधनं किमित्यतः प्रत्याहारसिद्धधारणादिरूपं ध्यानमित्याह - यद

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: nanu kaTan pratyaharasya paranasaDanata ? DyanasanaDilaksana- yogasyEva taTatvadityata aha- tan yoganititi tanityasya vivaranan- sTiranindriyaDarananiti indriyanan visayeByo vyavartanena Bagavadvisaye acancalan Darananeva DyanasanaDilaksanayoganiti nanyante prajna iti tayoranatiBedan vyanakti- apranata iti taTa satyapranato Bavati, Bagavajnanyeva BavatityarTa yogan nanyanta ityuktan tasya visayanaha - yogo hiti praBavapyayO utpativinasO jagato BagavatsakasadBavata ityetadyogo hi DyanarupaBagabadyogavisayo hiti 2.3.1 Endragnent
ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: nanu katan pratyaharasya paranasatanata ? tyanasanatilaksana- yokasyEva tatatvatityata aha- tan yokanititi tanityasya vivaranan- stiranintriyatarananiti intriyanan visayepyo vyavartanena pakavatvisaye acancalan tarananeva tyanasanatilaksanayokaniti nanyante pracna iti tayoranatipetan vyanakti- apranata iti tata satyapranato pavati, pakavacnanyeva pavatityarta yokan nanyanta ityuktan tasya visayanaha - yoko hiti prapavapyayO utpativinasO cakato pakavatsakasatpavata ityetatyoko hi tyanarupapakapatyokavisayo hiti 2.3.1 Entraknent
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थखण्डार्थ: ननु कथं प्रत्याहारस्य परमसाधनता ? ध्यानसमाधिलक्षण- योगस्यैव तथात्वादित्यत आह- तां योगमितीति तामित्यस्य विवरणम्-

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: na caksusa pasyatityupalaksanatvenoktan visadayati- nEva vaceti praptun jnatun na sakya purusa ityanukarsa kena tarhi jneya ityato hrdetyadina sravanadikan paranasaDananuktan, tasya guruprasadarupetikartavyatan vyatirekanuKenaha- astiti aparaDinataya sarvotanatvena asti prakrtapurusanana Bagavaniti bruvata upadisato guro anyatra, taTopadeswragurun vineti yavat, tad Bagavato rupan kaTanupalaByate ? na kaTanapi guruna pritipurvanupadese krte sravananananadi – svaprayatnena gurupradanasahitenopalaByate Bagavaniti tadaha sutrakara ‘“pradanavadeva hi taduktan’”(bra.su. 3-3-4 ) iti 2.3.12 Endragnent
ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: na caksusa pasyatityupalaksanatvenoktan visatayati- nEva vaceti praptun cnatun na sakya purusa ityanukarsa kena tarhi cneya ityato hrtetyatina sravanatikan paranasatananuktan, tasya kuruprasatarupetikartavyatan vyatirekanukenaha- astiti aparatinataya sarvotanatvena asti prakrtapurusanana pakavaniti pruvata upatisato kuro anyatra, tatopatestrakurun vineti yavat, tat pakavato rupan katanupalapyate ? na katanapi kuruna pritipurvanupatese krte sravananananati – svaprayatnena kurupratanasahitenopalapyate pakavaniti tataha sutrakara ‘“pratanavateva hi tatuktan’”(pra.su. 3-3-4 ) iti 2.3.12 Entraknent
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थखण्डार्थ: न चक्षुषा पश्यतीत्युपलक्षणत्वेनोक्तं विशदयति- नैव वाचेति प्राप्तुं ज्ञातुं न शक्यः पुरुष इत्यनुकर्षः केन तर्हि

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: setikartavyatakasravanadisvaprayatnanatradeva nopalaByate, kintu tajanyaBagavatprasadadeveti Bavena tadDetuktipurvakanaha- astityeveti uBayo prakrtipurusayo tatvan prananikatvan prakrtipurusaBavan va Bavayati sanpadayatiti tatvaBavo Bagavan tena, tatprasadeneti yavat, sarvasnadaDikataya astityeva jnatavya purusa ityanusanga na tu tatprasadena vina nuktihetu Bagavatprasadasca tatprasadajanyesvaravisayopalanBadityaha- astityeveti sarvaDikatayastitvadastitinana Bagavan ityupalabDasya, kartari nisWa, evanupalaBananasya tatvaBava praguktavyutpatya Bagavan prasidati paranaprasadavan Bavati 2.3.13 Endragnent
ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: setikartavyatakasravanatisvaprayatnanatrateva nopalapyate, kintu tacanyapakavatprasatateveti pavena tatetuktipurvakanaha- astityeveti upayo prakrtipurusayo tatvan prananikatvan prakrtipurusapavan va pavayati sanpatayatiti tatvapavo pakavan tena, tatprasateneti yavat, sarvasnatatikataya astityeva cnatavya purusa ityanusanka na tu tatprasatena vina nuktihetu pakavatprasatasca tatprasatacanyesvaravisayopalanpatityaha- astityeveti sarvatikatayastitvatastitinana pakavan ityupalaptasya, kartari nista, evanupalapananasya tatvapava prakuktavyutpatya pakavan prasitati paranaprasatavan pavati 2.3.13 Entraknent
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थखण्डार्थ: सेतिकर्तव्यताकश्रवणादिस्वप्रयत्नमात्रादेव नोपलभ्यते, किन्तु तज्जन्यभगवत्प्रसादादेवेति भावेन तद्धेतूक्तिपूर्वकमा

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: tadrsaprasadasaDyan Palanaha - yadeti paranaprasade sati pascadye hrdi sTita antakaranagata sarve kana te yada pranucyante, karnakartari - prayoga, nukta Bavanti, apagacCantiti yavat, aTa anantaran nartyonrto Bavati nrtin nEva prapadyate kuta ? atra svetadvipadisTanavisese brahna sanasnute prapnoti, tasnaditi yojyan 2.3.14 Endragnent
ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: tatrsaprasatasatyan palanaha - yateti paranaprasate sati pascatye hrti stita antakaranakata sarve kana te yata pranucyante, karnakartari - prayoka, nukta pavanti, apakacantiti yavat, ata anantaran nartyonrto pavati nrtin nEva prapatyate kuta ? atra svetatvipatistanavisese prahna sanasnute prapnoti, tasnatiti yocyan 2.3.14 Entraknent
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थखण्डार्थ: तादृशप्रसादसाध्यं फलमाह - यदेति परमप्रसादे सति पश्चाद्ये हृदि स्थिताः अन्तःकरणगताः सर्वे कामाः ते यदा प्रमुच्यन

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: hrdayagatasarvakanatyaga kadetyata tatkaranavidyahankarakarnanan hrdayagranTinan yada tyaga tadetyaha- yadeti iha nanusadehe hrdayasya sarve granTayo hrdayasTavidyadigranTayo yada praBidyante apayanti aTa tada sarvakanaprahanena nartya anrto nukto Bavati etavadanusasanan niskanakarna- sravananananaDyanakartavyoktiparan sastranetavat 2.3.15 Endragnent
ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: hrtayakatasarvakanatyaka katetyata tatkaranavityahankarakarnanan hrtayakrantinan yata tyaka tatetyaha- yateti iha nanusatehe hrtayasya sarve krantayo hrtayastavityatikrantayo yata prapityante apayanti ata tata sarvakanaprahanena nartya anrto nukto pavati etavatanusasanan niskanakarna- sravananananatyanakartavyoktiparan sastranetavat 2.3.15 Entraknent
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थखण्डार्थ: हृदयगतसर्वकामत्यागः कदेत्यतः तत्कारणाविद्याहङ्कारकर्मणां हृदयग्रन्थीनां यदा त्यागः तदेत्याह- यदेति इह मानुषदेहे

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: evan noksahetubrahnavidyanuktva jnanina caranadehaniskrananevasyan purvan Dyeyanarganaha- satanityadina hrdayasya hrdayasanbanDinyo naqya satan cEka ca ekotarasatan naqyo Bavanti tasan naDye eka naqi nurDananaBi prati nisrta tavatparyantan gata taya satotaraya susunaKyaya urDvan gacCan anrtatvaneti anyasca satan naqya visvagutkranane lokantaragananarTan Bavanti susunanarge jnaninan Dyeya iti Bava tadaha sutrakara n ‘“gatyanusnrtiyogaca hardanugrhita sataDikaya" ( bra. su. 4-2 - 17) iti 2.3.16 Endragnent
ck: srirakaventratirtakantarta: evan noksahetuprahnavityanuktva cnanina caranatehaniskrananevasyan purvan tyeyanarkanaha- satanityatina hrtayasya hrtayasanpantinyo natya satan cEka ca ekotarasatan natyo pavanti tasan natye eka nati nurtananapi prati nisrta tavatparyantan kata taya satotaraya susunakyaya urtvan kacan anrtatvaneti anyasca satan natya visvakutkranane lokantarakananartan pavanti susunanarke cnaninan tyeya iti pava tataha sutrakara n ‘“katyanusnrtiyokaca hartanukrhita satatikaya" ( pra. su. 4-2 - 17) iti 2.3.16 Entraknent
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थखण्डार्थ: एवं मोक्षहेतुब्रह्मविद्यामुक्त्वा ज्ञानिनः चरमदेहान्निष्क्रमणेऽवश्यं पूर्वं ध्येयमार्गमाह- शतमित्यादिना हृदयस्य

pk: sriraGavendratirTaKanqarTa: “ananyaprokte gatiratra nasti" ityadinoktan Bedajnananeva nuktiheturityupasanharati- angusWanatra iti antaratna antarvyapta iti va, antapreraka iti varTa jananan nanusadicetananan hrdaye sada sanyak suKenEva niviswa sTita tan svat svatnarupat sarirat, upalaksanan, jivaditi yavat, yadva svat svakiyajivarupacCariradityarTa jivo hi harivasatvat harinaDisWitatvadDare sariran DEryena DiraBavena suksnadrswyeti yavat pravrhet vivecayet Bedena janiyaditi yavat kaTan ? nunjadivesikan nunjapadena nOnjiDaranarTan kriyananarajusaDanatrnavisesa nunjat nunjapunjanaDyat isikaKyavijatiyatrnavisesaniveti yatu suDayan " dehatnatvan yadi na tat” iti BaktipadiyanuvyaKyanagananikayan dehajiva- parataya vyaKyatan, tatpararityEvetyaviroDa nunukso sokarahityasya anrtatvasya cavasyapeksitatvatasya tadrktvena BagavajnanenEva Bavyatvatajnana- navasyakaniti Bavenaha- taniti tan jivadBinan sukran sokadidosavarjitan, anrtan nityanuktan, anadyanantakalan sanpurnasvarupanandanuBavavantaniti yavat, tadrsanuBavasyEva nuktisabdarTatvat, vidyajaniyaditi aByasa- statparyarTa itisabdo vedanaprakaravaci ba, sanaptivaci va Dyeya Endragnent
